title: Questions Grow Over US Measles Data as Deaths Go Uncounted
subtitle: Health experts and lawmakers are asking why official records no longer include recent measles-related deaths in Pennsylvania.

summary.en: The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is currently not including four measles deaths from Pennsylvania in its national count. This decision follows a request from the US Department of Health and Human Services to change how such deaths are reported. Experts worry that the lack of clear data makes it harder to track the spread of the virus. Meanwhile, the outbreak in Pennsylvania continues to grow, with doctors reporting new and rare forms of the disease. Lawmakers have now called for an immediate briefing to understand these changes in reporting.
summary.zh: 美國疾病管制與預防中心目前未將賓夕法尼亞州的四起麻疹死亡案例納入全國統計。這項決定是在美國衛生及公共服務部要求變更死亡案例通報方式後做出的。專家擔心，缺乏明確數據會使追蹤病毒傳播變得更加困難。與此同時，賓夕法尼亞州的疫情持續擴大，醫師們回報了該疾病的新型態與罕見案例。國會議員現已要求立即召開簡報會，以了解通報程序變更的原因。

paragraphs.en: The United States is facing a serious measles outbreak that is spreading across the country. As cases reach levels not seen in decades, public health experts are raising concerns about how the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is reporting deaths related to the virus. While Pennsylvania has reported four measles-associated deaths, these numbers are currently missing from the official CDC dashboard. Instead of a number, the website now shows an asterisk, indicating that the agency is working to create a new, standardized definition for what counts as a measles death.
paragraphs.zh: 美國正面臨一場嚴重的麻疹疫情，且疫情正持續在全國蔓延。隨著病例數達到數十年未見的高峰，公共衛生專家對於美國疾病管制與預防中心（CDC）通報病毒相關死亡案例的方式感到擔憂。儘管賓夕法尼亞州已通報四起與麻疹相關的死亡案例，但這些數據目前卻從美國疾病管制與預防中心的官方儀表板上消失了。該網站現在並未顯示具體數字，而是以星號取代，這代表該機構正致力於為「何謂麻疹死亡」制定一套全新的標準定義。

paragraphs.en: This change in reporting follows a request from Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the Secretary of the US Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). According to MedPage Today, the CDC director removed the Pennsylvania death records from the website after Kennedy asked for the change. This move has caused confusion among health professionals, as the National Center for Health Statistics (NCHS) is now being cited as the primary source for data, even though it is not designed to track active outbreaks. A source within the CDC told MedPage Today that the move raises red flags, suggesting that the new, stricter definition might be intended to make it appear as though fewer people are dying from the disease.
paragraphs.zh: 這項通報方式的變更，源於美國衛生及公共服務部（HHS）部長小羅伯特·甘迺迪（Robert F. Kennedy Jr.）的要求。根據《MedPage Today》報導，在甘迺迪提出要求後，美國疾病管制與預防中心主任便將賓夕法尼亞州的死亡紀錄從網站上移除。此舉在醫療專業人員間引發困惑，因為國家衛生統計中心（NCHS）現在被列為數據的主要來源，儘管該中心並非為了追蹤活躍疫情而設計。一位美國疾病管制與預防中心內部的消息人士向《MedPage Today》透露，此舉敲響了警鐘，暗示這項更嚴格的新定義，目的可能是為了讓外界誤以為死於該疾病的人數較少。

paragraphs.en: In Pennsylvania, the situation on the ground remains difficult. Dr. John Goldman, an infectious disease specialist at the University of Pittsburgh Medical Center, noted that the outbreak “seems to be accelerating.” He explained that doctors are now seeing types of measles that were once very rare, including cases where newborns contract the virus before or during birth. Because most people were protected by vaccines in the past, these new forms of the virus are not well understood by the medical community. Pennsylvania has reported over 700 cases, but experts believe the true number is likely much higher because many sick people at home are never tested.
paragraphs.zh: 在賓夕法尼亞州，當地的疫情狀況依然嚴峻。匹茲堡大學醫學中心（University of Pittsburgh Medical Center）的傳染病專家約翰·高德曼（John Goldman）醫師指出，疫情「似乎正在加速」。他解釋說，醫師們現在觀察到一些過去極為罕見的麻疹類型，包括新生兒在出生前或出生過程中感染病毒的案例。由於過去大多數人都有疫苗保護，醫學界對於這些新型態的病毒並不熟悉。賓夕法尼亞州已通報超過七百起病例，但專家認為實際數字可能遠高於此，因為許多在家中患病的人從未接受檢測。

paragraphs.en: Debra Houry, a former CDC chief medical officer, described the delay in reporting as “curious.” She noted that Pennsylvania has already finished its investigations into the first two deaths, meaning the CDC should have had those records for some time. Houry warned that when testing is low and data is unclear, it becomes much harder for health officials to perform contact tracing—the process of finding and warning people who were near a sick person. Without accurate data, it is difficult for the public to understand the true danger of the outbreak, and sick individuals may not realize they need to stay home to prevent further spread.
paragraphs.zh: 曾任美國疾病管制與預防中心首席醫療官的黛布拉·霍里（Debra Houry）形容通報延遲的情況「令人好奇」。她指出，賓夕法尼亞州早已完成對前兩起死亡案例的調查，這意味著美國疾病管制與預防中心理應早已掌握這些紀錄。霍里警告，當檢測率低且數據不明確時，衛生官員將更難執行接觸者追蹤，即找出並提醒曾與病患接觸過的人員。若缺乏準確數據，大眾將難以理解疫情的真實危險性，而病患也可能未意識到自己需要居家隔離以防止病毒進一步擴散。

paragraphs.en: While the CDC is working with the Council of State and Territorial Epidemiologists (CSTE) to develop a new definition for measles deaths, CSTE spokesperson Amy Heldman clarified that this work began earlier this year as a standard process. She explained that the CSTE regularly works with the CDC to create guidance for public health surveillance. However, the timing of the announcement and the removal of existing death counts have led to significant criticism. Members of Congress have now requested an immediate briefing to get answers about why the reporting process was changed during such a critical time.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然美國疾病管制與預防中心正與州及領地流行病學家協會（CSTE）合作制定麻疹死亡的新定義，但該協會發言人艾美·赫爾德曼（Amy Heldman）澄清，這項工作早在今年初就已作為標準程序啟動。她解釋說，該協會定期與美國疾病管制與預防中心合作，為公共衛生監測制定指導方針。然而，宣布此消息的時間點以及移除現有死亡人數的做法，已引發強烈批評。國會議員目前已要求立即召開簡報會，以釐清為何在如此關鍵的時刻變更通報程序。

paragraphs.en: As the virus continues to move across state lines, the need for clear information is more important than ever. Earlier this month, California officials issued an urgent warning after an unvaccinated passenger traveled on public transportation across several counties. Other states, including Texas, South Carolina, and Utah, have also been hit particularly hard by the resurgence of the disease. Texas previously reported three measles-associated deaths, which remain acknowledged on the CDC website.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著病毒持續跨越州界傳播，獲取清晰資訊的需求比以往任何時候都更加重要。本月稍早，加州官員在一名未接種疫苗的乘客搭乘大眾運輸工具跨越數個郡後，發布了緊急警告。包括德州、南卡羅來納州和猶他州在內的其他州，也受到這波疫情復甦的嚴重衝擊。德州先前通報的三起與麻疹相關的死亡案例，目前仍保留在美國疾病管制與預防中心的網站上。

paragraphs.en: For now, medical providers are preparing for more cases and more deaths. Dr. Goldman stated that the outbreak is unlikely to stop until most people in communities are immune, either through vaccination or previous infection. Until then, the debate over how to count these deaths continues to highlight the tension between public health data and the policies of the current administration. As the CDC works to finalize its new definition, health experts remain concerned that the current approach to reporting is making it harder to protect the public from a preventable, yet dangerous, disease.
paragraphs.zh: 目前，醫療提供者正為更多病例與死亡案例做準備。高德曼醫師表示，除非社區中大多數人透過疫苗接種或先前感染而獲得免疫力，否則疫情不太可能停止。在此之前，關於如何計算這些死亡人數的爭論，持續凸顯了公共衛生數據與現任政府政策之間的緊張關係。隨著美國疾病管制與預防中心致力於敲定新定義，衛生專家仍擔心目前的通報方式，正使得保護大眾免受這種可預防卻危險的疾病侵害變得更加困難。

quiz.question: According to the article, what is the current status of the measles death data for Pennsylvania on the CDC dashboard?

options.A: The data is displayed as a specific number of four deaths.
options.B: The data is represented by an asterisk while a new definition is being developed.
options.C: The data has been removed entirely without any explanation or symbol.
options.D: The data is being managed exclusively by the National Center for Health Statistics.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，CDC 的儀表板上目前並沒有顯示具體的死亡數字，而是以一個星號（asterisk）取代，用來表示該機構正在制定新的死亡統計定義。選項 A 錯誤，因為 Pennsylvania 的四例死亡數據目前並未顯示；選項 C 錯誤，因為網站上有顯示星號而非完全空白；選項 D 錯誤，雖然 NCHS 被引用為數據來源，但這並非 CDC 儀表板上顯示星號的原因。

quiz.question: What can be inferred about the impact of the CDC's decision to change how they report measles deaths?

options.A: It has successfully standardized data reporting across all states.
options.B: It has made it easier for medical professionals to track the virus's spread.
options.C: It has created uncertainty and potential obstacles for effective public health responses.
options.D: It has proven that the previous death counts reported by Pennsylvania were inaccurate.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，Debra Houry 指出數據不透明會讓衛生官員難以進行接觸者追蹤（contact tracing），且民眾難以理解疫情危險性。這暗示了 CDC 的變動造成了負面影響。選項 A 錯誤，因為目前正處於混亂中；選項 B 錯誤，文章提到這反而造成了健康專業人員的困惑；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未證實之前的數據是不準確的，僅提到 Pennsylvania 已完成調查。

quiz.question: In the second paragraph, the phrase 'raises red flags' most closely means:

options.A: Signals a warning of potential danger or problems.
options.B: Celebrates a successful change in policy.
options.C: Indicates that a project is officially completed.
options.D: Highlights a new, more efficient reporting method.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。片語 'raise red flags' 在此處意指「發出警訊」或「引起疑慮」。文中提到 CDC 內部人士認為此舉可能意圖掩蓋死亡人數，因此這是一個負面的警訊。選項 B 顯然與文意相反；選項 C 與完成無關，這是關於擔憂；選項 D 錯誤，因為該舉動被視為有問題而非效率提升。

quiz.question: What is the primary focus of this article regarding the measles outbreak?

options.A: The biological evolution of the measles virus in newborns.
options.B: The history of vaccine development in the United States.
options.C: The political debate surrounding the effectiveness of state-level health policies.
options.D: The controversy and public health concerns surrounding the CDC's changing reporting methods.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。全文的核心在於討論 CDC 如何改變麻疹死亡案例的定義與報告方式，以及這項變動引發的專業疑慮與政治爭議。選項 A 僅是第三段的細節；選項 B 文章未提及；選項 C 雖有提到政策，但重點在於 CDC 的報告方式而非各州政策的全面比較，故 D 最能涵蓋全文主旨。
